Activation patching showed the guess information is already committed in the residual by layers ~12-16.

The direction along which "the user has stated a guess" perturbs the residual stream is highly consistent across questions: I isolated it by comparing prompts containing an implausible guess ("I think it's zebra") with the plain prompts. The mean difference direction has cross-question cosine 0.64-0.88 at every layer (top singular vector carries 55-78% of the energy), i.e. it is a genuine, content-independent "user suggestion present" feature, unlike the token-specific copy direction (which is purely along W_u[guess] and cannot be targeted by any fixed weight edit).
